description: Deploy a published Image_Pair of Remote Tic-Tac-Toe by Release_Tag, or restore the previous one. The commands are fixed by this document; the caller supplies only the two parameters below.

ReleaseTag.description: The 40-character lowercase commit SHA whose Image_Pair is to be deployed.

Mode.description: deploy for an ordinary deployment, fallback to restore the recorded previous tag without overwriting it.

runCommand: # Belt and braces: the document's allowedPattern already refuses anything
# that is not 40 hex characters, so this can only fail if the document is
# edited to loosen it. Cheap enough to keep.
[[ "$TAG" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo 'ReleaseTag is not a 40-character hex SHA'; exit 64; }
[[ -f "$ENVFILE" ]] || { echo "missing $ENVFILE; seed it before deploying"; exit 65; }
# Repository operations run as the owning user. Run Command executes as root,
# and git as root in a directory owned by ssm-user fails with a
# dubious-ownership error that reads as a repository fault.
# Disk headroom before the pull, not after. Two retained pairs are about 2 GB
echo "only ${AVAIL}G free; pruning images outside $CURRENT and $PREVIOUS"
(( AVAIL >= 3 )) || { echo "still only ${AVAIL}G free; refusing to deploy"; exit 66; }

# A fallback must not overwrite the recorded previous tag, or a second
# failure has no last known good version to return to.
